system.description:
Paranoid ruler of an iron city where every wall hides a listener.

  • Dark Gift (1st): Always know when you are being observed or followed, magical or mundane. Advantage on saves vs divination. Once per day, when you detect you are being watched or followed, gain advantage on your next initiative roll or saving throw.
  • Patron's Mark (4th): Once per day, listen through any iron or steel surface as if your ear were pressed against the other side for up to 10 minutes — you hear everything clearly regardless of thickness.
  • Patron Feature (8th): Once per day, learn a creature's allegiances, fears, and one secret without them knowing (no save, 60ft range).

Allegiance: Lawful Evil, the patron's alignment. Lore: Dispater in the World of Arneyan wiki.
